tool.name: 3Dtrees: ForestMamba
tool.command: mkdir -p input_files output_dir work_dir && #set $fname = str($input.element_identifier) #if not $fname.endswith('.' + str($input.ext)) #set $fname = $fname + '.' + str($input.ext) #end if ln -s '$input' 'input_files/${fname}' && python -u /workspace/src/run.py --dataset-path 'input_files/${fname}' --output-dir output_dir --work-dir 'work_dir/${fname}' --repo-dir /workspace --checkpoint '$checkpoint' --config-base '$config_base' --preprocess-workers '$preprocess_workers' --chunk-size '$chunk_size' --semantic-dim '$semantic_dim' --instance-dim '$instance_dim' --score-dim '$score_dim' --bluepoint-iterations 0 --bluepoint-second-pass-threshold 0.01 --spatial-match-tolerance 0.01

param.name: input
param.label: Input point cloud (LAZ/LAS)
param.help: One point-cloud file to segment with ForestMamba. Galaxy collection mapping runs this once per collection element.

param.label: Checkpoint path
param.help: ForestMamba checkpoint path inside the container.

param.label: Base config path
param.help: ForestMamba base config path inside the container.

param.label: Chunk size (points)
param.help: Point chunk size for tiled reads, staging, and LAZ writes.

param.label: Predicted semantic dimension name
param.help: Output dimension name for ForestMamba semantic labels.

validator.message: Use letters, numbers, and underscores only; start with a letter

param.label: Predicted instance dimension name
param.help: Output dimension name for ForestMamba tree instance IDs.

validator.message: Use letters, numbers, and underscores only; start with a letter

param.label: Predicted score dimension name
param.help: Output dimension name for ForestMamba confidence scores.

validator.message: Use letters, numbers, and underscores only; start with a letter

tool.help:
**What it does**
This tool runs ForestMamba semantic and instance segmentation on LAS/LAZ point clouds and writes the predictions back onto each input point cloud.
**Outputs**
- One enriched LAZ per input point cloud. - `summary.json` with the processed inputs and output dimension names.
Default output dimensions are `PredSemantic_FM`, `PredInstance_FM`, and `PredScore_FM`. GPU visibility is controlled by the Galaxy Docker runner.
